headline: Not open on Sunday 13 September 2026
detail: Apps Court Farm's car boot page now carries the banner "THE CAR BOOT IS NOT OPEN THIS SUNDAY". On Friday evening, 11 September, the same banner read "THE CAR BOOT IS OPEN THIS SUNDAY". Check the banner on the official page or call 01932 244 822 for the recorded status before travelling.
